paper_title: J-tau: A Fully Localized Japanese Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction
reason: J-tau는 tau-bench를 일본어로 현지화한 에이전트 벤치마크로, 과제 언어가 일본어이다. 이 인벤토리는 한국어(ko)와 영어(en) 과제만 다루므로 범위 밖이다. 논문 자체가 일본어 전용이라고 밝히며, 영어 원본 tau-bench는 이미 기존 행(tau2-bench)으로 등록되어 있고 이 논문이 영어 쪽에 실질적인 변경을 제안하지도 않는다.

screening.paper_title: J-tau: A Fully Localized Japanese Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction
screening.abstract: We present J-tau, the first publicly available Japanese benchmark for evaluating tool-using LLM agents in interactive customer-support scenarios. While tau-bench is widely used to evaluate LLM agents, it is English-centric and cannot evaluate agents in other languages. Existing multilingual extensions offer no public Japanese version and rely primarily on machine translation, leaving locale-specific entities such as addresses and currencies inconsistent with the target region. To enable reliable evaluation in Japanese, we carefully localize tau-bench through machine translation, entity adaptation, and human review. During this process, we also uncover and fix two flaws in the original tau-bench: invalid tasks and a score aggregation error that inflates certain models' results. Experiments show that J-tau yields fewer evaluation errors than a naively machine-translated counterpart and that our fixes resolve both flaws.
